nom: Clinique All About Eyes Brightening Serum Concentrate with Retinoid

segments.sensitive: Most reviewers who describe sensitive, reactive or aging-sensitive eyes report no irritation, crediting the fragrance-free, ophthalmologist-tested formula, though a minority describe burning, stinging, tingling, or in one case bumps under the eyes and cheeks that required hydrocortisone cream, consistent with the retinoid in the formula.
segments.mature: The couple of reviewers who mention their age report the serum works well for eyes that have become more sensitive or tired-looking as they've gotten older.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report a visible reduction in fine lines and smoother texture around the eyes with continued use, including reduced milia in one case; results are described as gradual, appearing after several weeks to a couple of months.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the under-eye area as more hydrated, softer and less tight after use; no reviewer reports it as drying.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports it helps with red and puffy eyes; this is an isolated mention.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports it lightened hyperpigmentation on her cheeks in addition to under-eye use, and another describes it targeting dark under-eye spots; this is thin material outside the product's main under-eye focus.
concerns.blemishes: The couple of reviewers who mention breakout history report no new breakouts, including one who says the product's vitamin C content usually triggers breakouts for her but did not here.

aspects.libelle: Small amount for a high price
Many see no visible improvement despite consistent use
Squeeze tube shoots product out unexpectedly

extraits.texte: So I followed the instructions 3 times a week in pm, but by the 2nd week day 2, under my eyes stared burning. So I stopped using it. A day later, I have small bumps all under my eyes and cheek that hurt when water or anything touched them. I have been putting hydrocortisone cream on my face for the last 4 days and they are starting to go down but still burn when I wash my face with my clinique soap. I had to stop using my clinique face scrub and clarify lotion because it hurt to put them on face. I hope the bumps are gone by the weekend! I have my husband 50th surprise party!!!!+

extraits.titre: Didn't Brighten My Eyes & Too Expensive for Amount in Bottle
extraits.texte: Unfortunately, just like other's reviews this serum didn't work to brighten my eyes, and for the expensive price, only a small amount is in the squeeze container. I wish I read the reviews. Clinique won't let me return this mediocre product unless I return the gift tote & samples with it. So not only do I get a poor quality product, I also get crappy customer service.

I received this product from Influenster. I have dark circles that are genetic, so nothing can fix that, aside from surgery. That being said, this cream is still great to prevent/treat fine lines. The cooling tip feels nice on my skin, and is convenient to apply the lotion with. I have very sensitive skin, and this did not cause any dryness or irritation. When squeezing the tube, the suction would cause some lotion to fly. No big deal, except the tube is pointed at my eye.

extraits.titre: Love the applicator, formula and texture of cream
extraits.texte: I was very glad to have received this product because I had been looking for eye creams. I am quite impressed with this formula as well as the packaging. Directions say to use twice a day but I only use it at night and I have to say that I can see a lot of difference in my under eye area. The area is overall brighter and appears healthier. I love that I don't have to use my fingers to spread the product because the lovely dispenser which also helps spread the product. I was also surprised because vitamin C breaks me out. But this product which contains it, has not made me break out. Love that!

This has become one of my favorite products to use!!! I received it a month ago as part of an influenster review program and was greatly surprised about how well it gave my eyes such a bright look and even helped to lighten some of the hyperpigmentation that I had on my cheeks. The cooling sensation it's metal applicator gives makes using the product so enjoyable

Wow, this is a beautiful eye retinol product! I will be buying again next time. It has improved the look of my milias. They are getting smaller. The undereye fine lines are also smoothing out, and my dark circles are slowly brightening. You need to carefully follow instruction before using to see the best results. The packaging is so nice. The tip is cooling. Also the retinol is strong but also gentle enough for daily use. I only aply it at night though because my skin is sensitive.
The roller ball is cooling to the under eye and helps with red and puffy eye. I really like it.

reserve: As with other eye creams, most reviews center on dark circles and puffiness, which fall outside the concern categories used here; a sizeable minority of reviewers also report no visible improvement despite weeks of consistent use, captured in the aspects list.
